data.Name: Impromptu Wrestling Match
data.Description: Two NPCs are locked in an intense wrestling match in the middle of the road. A crowd of woodland creatures watches. One NPC spots you and yells 'PERFECT! We need a referee! Or a third wrestler! YOUR CHOICE!' The other one is currently in a headlock and gives you a thumbs up.
data.Outcomes: [{"probability": 0.40, "type": "player_choice", "text": "Both wrestlers pause mid-grapple to look at you expectantly. One of them is upside down. Neither seems bothered by this.", "params": {"choices": [{"name": "Join the Wrestling Match", "risk": 0.5, "success": {"type": "spawn_ally", "text": "You execute a flawless suplex! The crowd goes WILD! The squirrels are doing the wave! Both NPCs are so impressed they want to join your adventure! Winner!", "params": {"deck": "beta_npc_deck.json", "count": 1}}, "failure": {"type": "damage_player", "damage": 5, "text": "You get immediately pile-driven into the dirt. You lose. Badly. A squirrel holds up a sign reading '0/10.' The NPCs help you up, still laughing."}}, {"name": "Judge Fairly as Referee", "risk": 0.0, "effect": {"type": "heal_player", "amount": 5, "text": "You make fair, impartial calls. Both wrestlers respect your integrity. They shake hands, share a meal, and insist you eat too. The wholesome energy literally heals you."}}]}}, {"probability": 0.20, "type": "none", "text": "They suddenly stop wrestling and start doing coordinated choreography. It was a dance-off all along! The woodland creatures provide backup vocals. You witness the greatest flash mob in RPG history.", "params": {}}, {"probability": 0.20, "type": "none", "text": "Both wrestlers simultaneously realize they forgot why they were fighting. They shrug, hug it out, and walk away arm in arm. The squirrel audience demands a refund.", "params": {}}, {"probability": 0.20, "type": "heal_player", "text": "Just watching the absurd spectacle fills you with joy. Laughter is the best medicine, and this is the funniest thing you've seen in three dungeons.", "params": {"amount": 3}}]
